senses.gloss: Ṛksha^1, a prince, son of Ajamīḍha. § 152 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3722, 3724 (son of Ajamīḍha and Dhūminī; father of Saṃvaraṇa).
Ṛksha^2, a prince, son of Ariha. § 156 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, 3777 (son of Ariha and Āṅgeyī), 3778 (husband of Jvālā and father of Matināra).
Ṛkshā^1, wife of Ajamīḍha. § 156 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, 3790 (fourth wife of Ajamīḍha).
Ṛkshaputra (“the son of Ṛksha^1”) = Saṃvaraṇa: I, 6527.

Ṛkshavat, name of a mountain. § 347 (Nalopākhyānap.): III, 61, 2317 (parvataṃ, towards the south).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 318 (only B., C. has Gandhamādanaṃ, among the kulaparvatāḥ of Bhāratavarsha).--§ 638b (Rāmopākhyāna): XII, 49, 1791 (Pauravadāyādo Vidūrathasutaḥ …ṛkshaiḥ saṃvardhitaḥ…Rºy atha parvate).--§ 639 (Rājadh.): XII, 52, †1893 (yathā mahānadī taṃ Rºantaṃ girim etya Narmadā, sc. puraś ca paścāc ca).
